user.title: Set up Steuertage
user.description: First choose the person, work location and threshold. The work location means the place you travel to for work, whose visits may be relevant to your commute-distance records. You can then set up optional features one at a time or skip them.

features.title: Optional features
features.description: Choose a feature to set it up. Afterwards, you can configure another feature or finish setup.

homeoffice.title: Homeoffice detection
homeoffice.description: Choose the home zone and device used to detect Homeoffice.

work_calendar.title: Work calendar
work_calendar.description: Choose a calendar integrated with Home Assistant. Timed and all-day entries are supported.

init.title: Steuertage settings
init.description: Adjust the person, work location and threshold. The work location means the place you travel to for work, whose visits may be relevant to your commute-distance records. Afterwards, configure, change or disable optional features.

manage.title: Optional features
manage.description: Choose a feature to configure or change. Active features can also be disabled here.
